input: Arrange a video call with my overseas siblings

gold.taskTitle: Arrange a video call with overseas siblings
gold.taskDescription: Plan and set up a video call between the user and their siblings who are located overseas.

questions.title: How many siblings are joining the call?
questions.description: Find out the total number of siblings who will be participating in the video call.

questions.title: Which countries are your siblings currently located in?
questions.description: Identify the specific countries or time zones where the overseas siblings are based, to help with scheduling.

questions.title: What is your target date for the call?
questions.description: Determine when the user wants the video call to take place — a specific date or a general timeframe.

questions.title: What video platform do you plan to use?
questions.description: Clarify which video calling tool will be used, such as Zoom, Google Meet, WhatsApp, FaceTime, or another platform.

questions.title: Who is responsible for sending the invites?
questions.description: Establish whether the user will send the meeting invitations themselves or if someone else will handle it.

questions.title: What is the main purpose or agenda of the call?
questions.description: Understand the reason for the call — casual catch-up, a special occasion, an important family discussion, etc.

questions.title: How long do you expect the call to last?
questions.description: Get an estimated duration for the call to help with scheduling and platform selection.
